questions.scenario: A mother is waking up her son for school in the morning.
questions.question:
Mom: Wake up, Kevin! It's eight o'clock.
Kevin: Oh no! ___________________
questions.explanation: 早上八點 (eight o'clock) 加上媽媽叫他起床 (waking up... for school) 的情境，最符合邏輯的後續是 It's time for school. (上學遲到了)。選項 B, C 是晚餐和午餐時間不符合早上；選項 D 睡覺時間也不合邏輯。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看懂情境上下文，只看到時間數字就隨便挑一個作息選項。

questions.scenario: Two students are waiting for their favorite cartoon at night.
questions.question:
Student A: The cartoon is at seven thirty.
Student B: ___________________
Student A: Let's turn on the TV!
questions.explanation: 前面的話題是卡通在『七點半』播出，朋友接著提問後，Student A 同意打開電視。這表示朋友問了現在幾點，發現時間到了。選項 B, C, D 疑問詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從對話中的時間事件反推對方問了『時間』(What time)。

questions.scenario: A family is looking at the clock around noon.
questions.question:
Dad: ___________________
Mom: It's twelve o'clock. Let's eat lunch.
questions.explanation: 詢問時間的正確句型為 What time is it?。選項 B 詞序錯誤；選項 C 將動詞 is 放在字尾 (直述句語序)；選項 D 把單數代名詞 it 搭錯 Be 動詞 are。
questions.commonMisconception: 套用中文『什麼時間它是』的直譯，或是將 is it 錯置為 it is。

questions.scenario: A boy comes home from playing outside at dusk.
questions.question:
Boy: I am very hungry, Mom.
Mom: Wash your hands. It's six o'clock. ___________________
questions.explanation: 傍晚六點且肚子餓，最符合的時間事件是晚餐 (dinner)。正確句型為 It's time for + 名詞。選項 B 早餐時間矛盾；選項 C 睡覺時間太早；選項 D 錯用介係詞 to 接名詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒學好『It's time for + Noun』與『It's time to + Verb』的差異，導致這題選到 D。

questions.scenario: A child is playing video games late at night.
questions.question:
Dad: Look at the clock! ___________________
Child: Okay, Dad. Good night.
options: Is it ten thirty? It's time to bed.
Is it ten thirty? It's time for bed.
It is ten thirty. It's time to bed.
It is ten thirty. It's time for bed.
questions.explanation: 爸爸指著時鐘陳述時間 (It is ten thirty) 並要求小孩去睡覺。介係詞應該使用 for 搭配名詞 bed (It's time for bed)。選項 B, D 的 Is it 是問句不合語氣；選項 C 錯用介係詞 to。
questions.commonMisconception: 把陳述句的 It is 跟疑問句 Is it 搞混，並且錯用介係詞 to + bed。

questions.scenario: Friends are planning to meet at the park in the afternoon.
questions.question:
Amy: Let's play in the park at _______________
Ben: Good. See you in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 根據 Ben 的回答『See you in the afternoon』(下午見)，四點 (four o'clock) 是唯一符合下午的時間點。其餘選項十點、九點、八點半皆屬於早上或晚上的時間。
questions.commonMisconception: 只看懂時間數字，卻沒有跟情境中的 in the afternoon (下午) 進行邏輯對照。

questions.scenario: A student asks the teacher about the scheduled test.
questions.question:
Student: Teacher, is the English test at nine o'clock?
Teacher: No, it isn't. ___________________
questions.explanation: 考試 (the English test) 是單數，使用代名詞 It。因為前面的問句 Is the test...? 被回答 No, it isn't.，老師接著要說明正確時間，必須用直述句 It is...。選項 B, D 用錯複數；選項 C 是問句語氣不合適。
questions.commonMisconception: 看到時間表達就隨意亂選，沒注意單複數代名詞 (It vs They) 以及直述/疑問句的語序差異。

questions.scenario: Two sisters are baking a cake in the afternoon.
questions.question:
Older sister: The cake needs 30 minutes.
Younger sister: It is two o'clock now. _______________
Older sister: Yes!
options: Is it time for a cake at two thirty?
Is it time to the cake at two thirty?
It are time for the cake at two thirty
It's time for the cake at two thirty.
questions.explanation: 現在兩點鐘，蛋糕需要三十分鐘，所以兩點半可以吃。妹妹是在自己推論並陳述 It's time for the cake...。選項 B 的 time to 不可接名詞；選項 C 錯用 are；選項 D 的 a cake (隨便一個蛋糕) 不符合前面正在做的特定蛋糕。
questions.commonMisconception: 不會做時間的推算 (2:00 + 30 分鐘 = 2:30)，並且對 time for / time to 用法模糊。

questions.scenario: A brother is rushing out the door for his baseball game.
questions.question:
Brother: ___________________
Mom: It's eight o'clock! Run!
questions.explanation: 媽媽回答了時間 (It's eight o'clock!) 並且叫他快跑。最標準且符合課綱的詢問時間句型是 What time is it?。選項 B 疑問詞錯誤；選項 C 在問年紀。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒記熟 What time is it? 的疑問句型，被其他類似的疑問詞混淆。

questions.scenario: A family is driving a car to the zoo on a weekend morning.
questions.question:
Girl: Dad, what time is it?
Dad: ___________________
Girl: Yay! The zoo opens at nine.
questions.explanation: 爸爸需要回答陳述句 It is + 時間。因為動物園九點才開，所以現在是八點半是合理選項。選項 B 用錯 are；選項 C, D 為問句，無法回答小女孩的問題。
questions.commonMisconception: 爸爸在回答時錯用成了疑問句的形式 (Is it...) 或搭錯 Be 動詞。
